items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: He and I were good friends, too.

ctx.x: This is Billy Berg's club, right?

Billy Berg's Capri. And Elmer Fain said, 'Hey, do you want to go with Duke?' And I said, 'Wow, that's wonderful, but I really would rather stay here and learn more about music.' Because I knew if I went with Duke, I'd never get to play my tuba and I'd never get to write. And I was writing for Lee and Lester's band, and I also wrote for a lot of bands... I used to write for shows around town.
But before that, let me to 19...
